shadows.name: action-hover
shadows.purpose: Adds a restrained downward response to the primary action.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single high-confidence action on a persuasive surface.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:14px 28px; border-radius:12px; background:oklch(69.6% 0.17 162.48); color:oklch(26.2% 0.051 172.552); font:700 16px/1 'Archivo Variable',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .2s,transform .2s,box-shadow .2s; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background:oklch(76.5% 0.177 163.223); transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(16,185,129,.18); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(84.5% 0.143 164.978); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Terminal Panel
components.description: The one elevated operational surface for real commands and state.
components.css: .ds-terminal { overflow:hidden; margin:0; border:1px solid oklch(37% .013 285.805); border-radius:14px; background:#070a08; color:oklch(98.5% 0 0); box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.48); font:400 14px/1.7 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; } .ds-terminal-bar { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:16px 24px; border-bottom:1px solid oklch(37% .013 285.805); background:#18181b; color:oklch(70.5% .015 286.067); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-terminal-bar span { color:oklch(76.5% .177 163.223); } .ds-terminal pre { margin:0; padding:28px; font:inherit; }

components.name: Stage Marker
components.description: A numbered point on a meaningful connected sequence.
components.css: .ds-stage-marker { display:inline-flex; width:40px; height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid oklch(69.6% .17 162.48); border-radius:9999px; background:#030806; color:oklch(84.5% .143 164.978); font:400 14px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; transition:background-color .2s,color .2s; } .ds-stage-marker:hover { background:oklch(69.6% .17 162.48); color:oklch(26.2% .051 172.552); }

components.name: Status Label
components.description: Compact factual metadata paired with a signal point.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:oklch(95% .052 163.051 / .7); font:600 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; letter-spacing:.14em; } .ds-status i { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:9999px; background:oklch(69.6% .17 162.48); }

components.name: Footer Link
components.description: A low-priority source reference on the night field.
components.css: .ds-footer-link { color:oklch(55.2% .016 285.938); font:400 12px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace; text-decoration-color:oklch(37% .013 285.805); text-underline-offset:4px; transition:color .2s; } .ds-footer-link:hover { color:oklch(76.5% .177 163.223); } .ds-footer-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(76.5% .177 163.223); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: Minegr treats the interface as one operational field: near-black space is interrupted by a broad green signal, precise rules, and the occasional contained terminal surface. Scale and overlap make the work memorable; restrained controls keep it credible. The system is technical without dressing every element as a terminal.
keyCharacteristics: Monumental wide display type against quiet open space.
One committed emerald signal over charcoal-black fields.
Exact rules and connected sequences instead of generic card grids.
Matte surfaces with one selectively elevated operational pane.
A single authored motion event with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Signal Field Rule
rules.body: Green may own a large continuous region or one active state; do not scatter small green decorations across unrelated elements.

rules.name: The Evidence Mono Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only for commands, measurements, and status metadata.

rules.name: The One Lifted Surface Rule
rules.body: Elevate the active operational surface; leave surrounding page regions on the field.

dos: Do use broad green fields to connect content regions.
Do create hierarchy with scale, overlap, and negative space.
Do keep planned functionality visibly labeled during pre-alpha.
Do keep repeated content in typed data structures rather than duplicating markup.
donts: Don't use literal Minecraft imagery, pixel fonts, creatures, blocks, or game screenshots as brand language.
Don't turn technical content into neon, glass, or glow-heavy chrome.
Don't use same-size icon cards as the page structure.
Don't use monospace outside code, data, and real operational metadata.
